assets.title: 기본 네이비 홈
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished, implementable, high-fidelity Korean university academic advising web app screenshot. Product name exactly "외대 놓침방지". This is a personal academic chatbot that remembers a student profile. Not a marketing landing page. Flat straight-on interface, no device frame, no photograph, no 3D props, no perspective. Landscape desktop 1920 x 1200 intended canvas with generous readable Korean text using Pretendard/Noto Sans KR. High-quality spacing and typography, 8px spacing grid, 12-16px corner radii, hairline borders, restrained shadows. No existing product logos or university seal. A small simple original open-book line glyph may accompany the product name.
The actual functions are only profile registration, profile-aware academic chat, evidence sources, requesting missing details, conflicting sources, hypothetical questions, profile edit/delete. No login, no GPA dashboard, no calendar view, no pet, no charts unrelated to a direct answer, no fabricated student name. Local profile only, not synced. All visible copy Korean, polite concise product language, never profanity.
Standard shell for core desktop screens: elegant narrow left sidebar about 220px, subtle top bar and main workspace. Simple nav "새 질문", "내 학사 프로필", "지원 범위"; topics "졸업학점", "이중전공·부전공", "휴·복학". Full screen sharp and legible. No tiny walls of text.
Style: refined academic trust, navy ink #072C4C, pale cool-white #F5F7FA, white content surfaces, restrained muted teal accents. Sidebar is very pale blue-gray; navy appears primarily on selected nav and primary buttons. Inspired by calm conversational workspaces and Korean readable financial interfaces, but original layout. No purple gradient, no glassmorphism.
Screen: personalized chat home before a question. Spacious calm layout with the chat composer as the primary action. Main heading exactly "내 정보를 기억하는 학사 도우미"; small subheading "매번 설명하지 않아도, 내 조건에 맞게 답해요." Under heading, large elegant question input with placeholder "학사 관련 궁금한 점을 물어보세요" and a navy send arrow. A slim badge near input reads "내 프로필 적용 중". Below, three balanced suggestion cards with short labels "졸업학점", "전공 신청", "휴·복학" and example questions "졸업하려면 몇 학점 필요해요?", "이중전공 신청은 어떻게 해요?", "다음 학기에 휴학할 수 있나요?". A right utility column with a refined profile summary headed "내 학사 프로필", a small "수정" link, profile chips "서울캠퍼스", "2026학번", "스페인어과", "2학기", "신입학 · 재학", "이중전공". A short "이 기기에 저장됨" footer with a lock icon. Below it one restrained contextual notice "나에게 해당하는 안내", "이중전공 신청", "11.24 10:00 – 11.30 16:00", action "자세히 물어보기". Keep that notice secondary to the chatbot. Do not invent due-day counts. Header right a small profile/settings icon, not a human avatar.
